versions.changelog: v1.0.4 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Security review fixes (17 findings). Command safety: user text is never interpolated into shell strings - pass arguments separately, quote variables, use --flag=value, prefer an argv array in PowerShell, and never use eval / sh -c / Invoke-Expression, string concatenation, user text as an option, or user text in structural positions (command, path, channel, agent id); restate the final argv before running. Executable discovery no longer searches user-writable directories: when openclaw is not in a known install location or PATH the skill asks the user, and verifies the candidate before executing it. Activation is narrowed with explicit exclusions, and commands are tiered (read-only / side-effecting / externally-visible) with confirmation required before dispatching an agent or sending a channel message. The README warns that channel operations reach real recipients and that nothing is persisted (env vars are session-scoped). The hero comment block was removed and its subtitle made bilingual. Docs default to Chinese and the skill answers in the user's language. Repo-side docs are excluded from the published bundle.

- Simplified and clarified the skill's description for easier understanding.
- No functional changes to commands or usage.
- Language and documentation improvements for better cross-tool usability.
- Maintained explicit permissions, boundaries, and prohibited actions.

xiaoyaoclaw-commander 1.0.0

- Initial release of the xiaoyaoclaw-commander skill.
- Allows any Agent Skills-compatible tool (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Trae, DSH) to command the local XiaoyaoClaw / OpenClaw gateway.
- Supports running agent tasks, sending messages via OpenClaw channels (Feishu/Telegram), and checking agent/gateway status.
- Enforces strict agent selection, explicit confirmation for external actions, and cautious environment/config handling. No config file changes, no hardcoded paths, and no credential storage.
- Includes thorough documentation and usage guidance in both English and Chinese.
